pr_title: Bring `TabBar` to full parity with the `TabContainer` implementation.
pr_body:
### What this PR does:
- Adds the ability to hide tabs.
- Adds an option to turn off the behavior of always keeping the selected tab visible.
- Fixes error spam when setting the tab count below the index of the selected tab.
- Fixes `tab_rmb_clicked` signal being fired by clicking the right tab button (which was not even exposed!) instead of when the tab is right clicked.
- Fixes some regressions related to RTL mode.
- Fixes #57181.
- Renames the following theme properties: `close_bg_highlight` -> `button_highlight`; `close_bg_pressed` -> `button_pressed`.
- Exposes `set/get_tab_right_button()` and renames them to `set/get_tab_button_icon()`.
- Adds a proper signal for when the right button is pressed (`tab_button_pressed`).
- Adds a `tab_selected` signal.
- Adds missing documentation.

### What this PR does NOT do:
- Expose `min_width`, behavior that lets tabs shrink to a certain size if there's not enough space.

As much as this would be nice to have, the behavior is broken before, and is broken now. It's only used by the scene tabs, and it only "works" there because of the weird implementation of clearing all tabs after doing pretty much anything. Maybe me or someone else can salvage that one day.

*Bugsquad edit: This closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/3846.*
pr_comments:
I did some testing (mostly for the points you listed) and
- `set_tab_hidden()` doesn't change tab if it hides current tab. Is that intended?
- `keep_current_tab_visible` suggests that the tab will be visible no matter what, but in fact the TabBar just scrolls to it when it's selected. Something like `scroll_to_selected` would be more clear
- Not really related, but `tab_rmb_clicked` requires `select_with_rmb` to be enabled. It would be nice to mention it in the description
- Since the method is now exposed, `right_button_icon` is a bit confusing name. It suggests some icon related to right mouse button. Maybe simply `button_icon` would be better? And the description should just mention that the button is placed on the right side

@KoBeWi

> `set_tab_hidden()` doesn't change tab if it hides current tab. Is that intended?

Yes. Currently, in `TabContainer` it tries to switch to next tab to the right and then gives up. I think it's for the best to leave to the user to choose what to do when hiding a tab, as there are certain situations where having the hidden tab selected can be useful (e.g.: a welcome screen that only appears before picking a tab).

I did all the renames requested.

The PR breaks unclipped tabs:
![godot windows tools 64_UOa9HpQv8V](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2223172/151718087-1ac85a24-e835-40f9-82a9-a83fdb004faa.gif)
They don't have correct minimum size.

Scroll offset doesn't ignore hidden tabs.

All tabs visible:
![godot windows tools 64_uReXbJhQwE](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2223172/151718472-21b6d09c-56f0-4a53-8f64-2441aefa3d76.gif)

Tab2 hidden:
![godot windows tools 64_McE9OA9b05](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2223172/151718497-fd585fee-3178-417b-af21-b7a2088e9f20.gif)

Might not be related to this PR, but icon and right/close button overlap if there is no text:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2223172/151722855-0e3fb4a9-8ffd-4776-bc71-097f7ccc616a.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2223172/151722911-27b93e08-2d5b-45b2-9c0e-6c480612fb64.png)

> Scroll offset doesn't ignore hidden tabs.

This is also a bug in `TabContainer`, and due how the offset system works, it would require some significantly extra work to fix it both here and there. I plan to tackle that some other time.

The other issues pointed out have been fixed or explained.

issue_context.title: Tabs control glitch
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

v3.5.beta1.official [b9b23d222]

### System information

Windows 10, GLES3

### Issue description

If set tabs switching by hovering on them, and move mouse only on first two, then sometimes tabs not under mouse suddenly selected.

Also in that case, method get_tab_rect periodically returns different result.

### Steps to reproduce

Full example attached in project.zip

Add Tabs control
Create script on Tabs
Create several tabs in script
Connect tab_hover signal to script and make here setting current_tab by recieved tab argument.

### Minimal reproduction project


https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/13046849/150940905-f0d3b5f2-ac30-4b9f-ba74-7dc520fbf32f.mp4

[project.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/7931889/project.zip)
comments: Great job! Thank you! This fix will be backported in 3.x? @YeldhamDev
@filantus Unlikely for now, as this was fixed as the result of a near complete rewrite of the tab system.

review_comments: Control nodes start with a size of 40x40 at the start. However, `TabBar` with the default theming is shorter in height than that, so this line makes sure it isn't unnecessary taller than it should.
Seeing as this code is repeated many times, maybe it could be moved to a method? Something like `refresh_all()` idk.
Those group of functions don't always carry all those functions, as some would be unnecessary steps in some occasions. So there isn't a "one size fits it all" to throw into a single function.
Searching this brings 8 exact results, but ok.
